NBA DFS Rankings for Sunday, November 15 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 5 games · First game 6:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 15, 8:21 PM ET

Jalen Johnson (ATL) ranks first on the Sunday, November 15 DraftKings main slate at 51.1 projected DraftKings points for $9,600. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 49.6) and Alperen Sengun (HOU, 48.6) are next.

The table ranks the top 100 of 123 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 15, 8:21 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
